A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]

# Choose candidate with fingers aligned along the short axis (fits_open_fingers=True) and grasp below the top

grasp_height = pen["top_z"] - 0.005  # 5mm below top to ensure grip
grasp({
    "x": candidate["x"],
    "y": candidate["y"],
    "height": grasp_height,
    "yaw": pen["long_axis_yaw"],
    "object": "yellow_pen",
    "source": candidate["source"],
    "squeeze_width": candidate["squeeze_width"],
    "fits_open_fingers": candidate["fits_open_fingers"],
    "id": candidate["id"]
})
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
